verdict.rationale: DBOS is a durable-workflow library with a Conductor console, so built-in AI insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions. The MCP server only lets an external LLM or agent analyze workflows, which is a building block outside the product rather than insights delivered inside it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
